description: Look up a periodic table element by name, chemical symbol, or atomic number. Returns the full data record: atomic number, symbol, name, atomic mass (in unified atomic mass units), electron configuration, group, period, block, category (e.g., "noble gas", "transition metal"), Pauling electronegativity, density (g/cm³), melting and boiling points in kelvin, and discovery year. Properties unavailable for synthetic or insufficiently studied elements are returned as null.

by.description: Lookup mode: auto tries atomic number, then symbol, then name.

query.description: Element name (e.g., "tungsten"), chemical symbol (e.g., "W"), or atomic number as a string (e.g., "74").

name: ref_element_lookup

appearance.description: Physical appearance description. Null for synthetic elements not macroscopically observed.

atomic_mass.description: Standard atomic mass in unified atomic mass units (u). Null for unstable elements with no standard mass.

atomic_mass_estimated.description: True when the atomic mass is estimated or based on the most stable isotope rather than a natural abundance average.

block.description: Electron block: s, p, d, or f.

boiling_point_k.description: Boiling point in kelvin at standard pressure. Null for unstable or synthetic elements.

density_g_per_cm3.description: Density in grams per cubic centimeter at STP. Null for synthetic or poorly studied elements.

discovery_scientists.description: Scientist(s) credited with discovery. Null for elements known since antiquity.

discovery_year.description: Year of discovery. Null for elements known since antiquity.

electron_configuration.description: Electron configuration using noble gas shorthand (e.g., "[Ar] 3d6 4s2").

electronegativity_pauling.description: Pauling electronegativity scale value. Null for noble gases and heavy synthetic elements.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No element matched the query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

group.description: Periodic table group number (1–18). Null for lanthanides and actinides.

melting_point_k.description: Melting point in kelvin at standard pressure. Null for unstable or synthetic elements.

natural.description: True if the element occurs naturally on Earth.

phase_at_stp.description: Phase at standard temperature and pressure: Solid, Liquid, or Gas.

radioactive.description: True if all isotopes are radioactive (no stable isotopes).

title: Element Lookup
